evidence.reason: checkoutWriterContext.removed() now propagates the removal to its parent context (like begin()/bindCoordinates()), so a parent-owned slot reused through find() is unbound and incomplete instead of remaining bound to the deleted checkout, allowing the parent's complete() to reconcile.
